name: ef_trigger_source
purpose: Split EF fires by WHAT MOVED since the previous decide pass, so London can check whether its own 69%-fill bucket (attempt-1 on a book <50 ms old) is where its money actually is. This is a MEASUREMENT SPEC, not a filter: the filter version failed verify.py on Zurich and must not be deployed anywhere.

failed_gates: permutation p=0.966 with permuted mean +0.319 above real +0.177
paired McNemar p=1.000, 66 of 67 candles identical

inputs_required_per_pass.ts_ms: pass time in ms, to order within the candle
inputs_required_per_pass.side: the side the engine chose on this pass, UP or DOWN
inputs_required_per_pass.up_ask: book ask on the UP token at this pass
inputs_required_per_pass.dn_ask: book ask on the DOWN token at this pass
inputs_required_per_pass.p: the model probability for `side` on this pass (RAW p; apply your own calibration separately)

rule.compare_with: the immediately preceding pass in the SAME candle, ordered by ts_ms
rule.own_ask_now: up_ask if side==UP else dn_ask, on THIS pass
rule.own_ask_prev: up_ask if side==UP else dn_ask, on the PREVIOUS pass - read OUR side on both rows so a side change does not corrupt the ask comparison
rule.dp: p_now - p_prev, and ONLY when prev.side == side

classes.BOOK-dn: book_moved and not model_moved and dask < 0
classes.BOOK-up: book_moved and not model_moved and dask > 0
classes.FIRST: no previous pass in the candle, or no usable previous quote on our side

rule.do_not_convert_dp_across_a_side_flip: measured on Zurich, p is not symmetric across a flip: residual mean +0.0715, 0.0% of flips within 0.02, because the flip is itself selected on p having moved

zurich_reference_numbers.note: SIMULATED fills (FAK at ask+1 tick filling iff the +250 ms ask is within a tick, at that ask)
consistency_checks_that_should_reproduce: BOOK-up and NEITHER are both exactly 0 among first-qualifying fires: a pass whose only change is the ask moving AWAY cannot be the first to cross an EV bar, and neither can a pass where nothing moved
side flips are ~62% of raw25 fires, because a fire is usually the pass where the engine switches to the side that just crossed the bar
the logged ask equals the own-side book ask on 852162/852162 Zurich rows

what_london_should_measure: split REAL fills (not attempts) by class, and report fill% and per $1 per class
cross the class against London's own book-age bucket (<50 ms vs older) - Zurich has NO quote-age column, so this is the one thing Zurich cannot do and London can
the prediction to test: the 69% bucket is the BOOK-triggered population, and Zurich says it pays -0.007/$1 while the 36%-fill MODEL population pays +0.234
if_the_prediction_holds: then raising the fill rate is not an improvement by itself, and the <50 ms attempt-1 result should not be used as a reason to chase fills
